name: How can I prepare my Dallas–Fort Worth property for a multi-generational living unit consultation with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: How can I prepare my Dallas–Fort Worth property for a multi-generational living unit consultation with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for a consultation regarding a multi-generational living unit, consider your family's specific needs, desired features, and any preliminary ideas you have for the space. Gathering inspiration photos or sketches can be helpful. We recommend thinking about the current challenges you face with your living arrangements and how an additional unit could resolve them. This preparation allows us to better understand your vision and provide a more accurate and personalized assessment during our initial discussion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare for a consultation by considering your family's needs, desired features, and preliminary ideas for the space, including current living arrangement challenges. This helps us provide a personalized assessment.
